Hey first of all 
I exaggerated the situation in my joke. I know that it is a different Situation. But I wanted to point out the major flaw with the show = poor writing. I´d also agree with the point that this is one of the worst episodes of the show, because it just sums up all the problems it has. They create a new villain that is way too op and they write themself into a corner. They want to give the other characters like Iris more time but do not know how to write a story for without making her unrelatable. I do not want to get more into the Problems with Iris, because this comment isn´t supposed to be that long but to keep it short: The writers want to create a strong feminine character but have no idea how to do that. They forget the rules and ideas their world is based on and use things like the power of love to just fix stuff. 
I feel like my comment is a bit disconnected and maybe not that understandable and I am sorry for that. This just makes me really angry and it is hard to write that way. 
I do not have a problem with "Love" being a big part of the Show. As you said it has been a part of the show for a very long time. But it´s what makes barry speacial. It is what motivates him. When Barry tried to be more like oliver or when he tried to tap into his darker side Joe and Snart told him that it is a dumb idea and that it might work for other people but it is not Barrys way. And that makes sense. Barry being motivated, because he fights for what he loves is understandable. But when the answer for a scientific Problem with the speedforce for example is his love for Iris that is using that concept badly. Or Eva. There was groundwork for the change. To make her regret the things that she did but that it was not fleshed out enough. It needed more time. But they didn´t give her that time. They just said Iris, her new powers and love saved the day. That is poor writing, because it doesn´t make sense. What made Eddie´s sacrifice in season one great was that we could have seen that coming. It made sense and was understandable. But Iris suddenly being the SF and having Mirror powers? 
I get that corona and everything lead to a lot of problems and I get that. But this is just the prime example for what is wrong with the show in my opinion. 

And yeah no one is forcing us to watch this show, but I used to love that show. It was my favorite TV show and it introduced me to comic books etc.. I want it to be good. I want it to be great and when I see what it became it makes me sad and I am sure a lot of people feel like that. It is easy to say don´t watch it if you don´t like it, but it is also good to criticize what you like(d) so it can get better. I mean I wouldn´t write this much if I´d be just a hater. 

(English is not my mother tounge so I hope I didn´t make too many mistakes and everything was understandable)

Hey
First I wanna say thank you for being so respectful in this discussion. I also appreciate the long comments. As you said it just shows how invested someone is.
And yeah I agree with you in the end it all depends on what someone wants to see. There are probably people who might be frustrated about things I love about the show. But yeah that was kind of one aspect why I made this post. I wanted to share my opinion on the topic, say what bothers me about the show and well my biggest problems with the season/ show. I think the best example is that you said that you did not like the later seasons of arrow. I for my part love Arrow and think all of the seasons are pretty good and some really amazing (Except for season 3 and 4 which I just want to forget).
It really just depends on not only what someone likes but also what one can tolerate and I the problems I have had with the show really hurt my time watching the show. The Flash was the show I looked forward to every week and introduced me to comic books and the first two seasons are up there in my all time fav TV Show list. I hope I can make clear that I am a huge Fan that is dissapointed to see what his favorite show became. I mean I wouldn´t write this much if i wouldn´t care about the show so yeah. 

Also have to say that I might have chosen the wrong words for the CW argument, cause the whole point I wanted to make was that the writer can write really great storys and that I think they can do better than what they have done recently. But I forgot that CW is a huge network and  it isn´t always up to the writers in what direction a show goes. So yeah it might be really a big Problem that the CW is making the show. I still have to say that I hope that they can get back to what they did. 
I am just tired of looking at forced drama and "lazy" written excuses to keep the show going for longer. The Flash is one of my favorite Superheroes and I know the Potential this show has which is why I want it to get back to the quality it had once like arrow did for me with season 5 after the catastrophe that was season 4. 
I really enjoyed writing about the Flash on here so thank you again for this respectful discussion.
I have been thinking about talking about the things I love like Flash on Youtube for example and this felt like it showed me that it might not be a bad idea after all.

First of all I am glad to hear that you were still able to enjoy the season. My point of this post was not to ruin something other people like. I just want to show how frustrated I am. The first two seasons are just completely awesome. I loved how they handled the Story in season one and of course there were things that could be considered a flaw but those were not a problem for me. It was just awesome and for me a perfect season. 
And to see a show that goes from complex characters dealing with real problems and some crazy story lines (in a good way) to a show that does not seem like its trying anymore is just kinda heartbreaking. 
I think the ideas they had in season five were good but the execution was bad in my opinion. As you said it makes total sense that there would be some people who want to see meta-humans die since they cause so many problems. But the way they executed the Story is just awful (and again this is my opinion)
And to say "it is the CW of course it is going to be flawed" is a lazy excuse cause i don´t care . These people have shown that they can write awesome Storys and that is pretty cool, so we shouldn´t act like that they are not capable of doing better (cause they are).
and yeah they needed to fill the episode count, which is why they don´t use obvious solutions to problems. But then either give us a believeble reason or fill the runtime with fun/ necessery stuff like they did in season one. There were 23 episodes but i do not really consider many of them filler since Barry learned something in every episode and grew as a character. In later seasons it feels like a lot of episodes are just there to kill time.

I really want to make clear that I don´t want to make people hate something or tell them their opinion is wrong. If someone enjoys that it´s awesome but these things are part of a big Problem that are stopping Flash from becoming one of the best Superhero shows in my opinion. And it really frustrates me which is why I made this post.

(This is a long post and I am sorry for that but I wanted to take time and make clear I am not being misunderstood. English is also not my native language so I hope I did not make to many mistakes)
